title: Use ElevenLabs Voice
desc: Note: Requires an ElevenLabs account and an API key stored in EDCoPilot / ElevenLabsCache / ElevenLabsAPIKey.txt. IMPORTANT REMINDERS: 1. You are solely responsible for ensuring you have permission to use cloned or custom voices, particularly in public broadcasts or shared audio/video content. EDCoPilot does not assume liability for any misuse. Use of unauthorized voices may violate intellectual property laws and is done entirely at your own risk. 2. You are responsible for usage charges on your Cloud voice account.

title: ElevenLabs Voice
desc: Change the voice used by your copilot

title: ElevenLabs Voice Stability
desc: Set a value between 0.0 and 1.0. A higher value will make the voice more monotone. A lower value will make the voice more expressive, but can lead to voice instabilities.

title: ElevenLabs Voice Similarity
desc: Select value between 0.0 and 1.0. A higher value will increase clarity and target voice similarity. A lower value is recommended if there are background noises in your gnerated speech.

title: ElevenLabs Voice Style
desc: Select value between 0.0 and 1.0. A higher value will attempt to amplify the style of the original speaker. Might increase latency if set to anything other than 0.0

title: ElevenLabs Voice Speaker Boost
desc: Boosts the similarity to the original speaker, but might increase latency. Effect of this setting are generally very subtle
